craftHeading: Care in the parts you see—and the parts you don't.
whoText: We work with homeowners, landlords, investors, property managers, businesses and commercial property owners. Every property and brief is different, so we start by listening and understanding what the work needs to achieve. We then discuss the scope and practical considerations openly, so decisions are based on the building and the customer's priorities.
craftText: With a deep background centred around property investment, after renovating rental properties at age 16, and at 18 going into a carpentry apprenticeship. Ive seen and witnessed a lot. After witnessing some terrible work attitude and craftsmanship even on high end residential and commercial projects, I couldn't stand by and let others pull me down. I wanted to do work that genuinely cared about quality and service. Working as though it was our own home and project. Making sure its done right even when no one sees it. I can guarantee that every project has every ounce of thought and effort put into it and wont be left in the shadow. That at the end of the day we always pack up with a good heart and our soul is more fulfilled knowing that our clients will be just as pleased as we are.
heroIntro: ANDRO Construction + Projects was established in Auckland in 2020 to bring care, practical thinking and attention to detail to construction, renovations and property maintenance.

badge.alt: Site Safe Member — Proud to be safe

visionText: We want ANDRO to be known for craftsmanship, quality and service—not as a slogan, but in the way we communicate, plan and complete work. We value long-term relationships and the reassurance that comes from knowing who is looking after your property.
visionHeading: A business built on trust over time.
